jobs.occupation: Warehouse operator at DSV Contract Logistics B.V.
jobs.description: As a warehouse operator at DSV Contract Logistics B.V., you make sure goods move quickly and safely to the right place. You’ll work in a close-knit team, get lots of responsibility, and learn every day. This is your chance to really make an impact in logistics! Wat ga je doen? As a warehouse operator, you’re the key player in the logistics process. You unload trucks and containers, stack goods on pallets, and make sure everything is scanned, labeled, and shrink-wrapped correctly. You use internal transport equipment like forklifts and reach trucks to move everything quickly and safely. You count inventory, pick orders, and get them ready for shipping. You also help with value-added activities like packaging or labeling products. You’ll work full time (40 hours a week), mostly in day shifts. Together with your colleagues, you keep the warehouse tidy and safe. You work closely with your team leader and supervisor, and your day flies by thanks to the variety of tasks. Speed, accuracy, and safety are always at the heart of your job as a warehouse operator. Waar ga je werken? DSV Contract Logistics B.V. Is a global leader in transport and logistics. At the Moerdijk location, you will work in one of the largest and most advanced warehouses in the Netherlands and the surrounding region, equipped with the latest warehouse technology.Safety, teamwork, and a well-organized workplace are top priorities. DSV values its employees by providing clear communication, structured planning, and plenty of opportunities for personal and professional development. Wie ben je? This is what we ask from you:- You are at least 18 years old and have a VMBO level of education or equivalent working and thinking level;- You have a good command of the English language;- You enjoy working as part of a team;- You live within commuting distance of Moerdijk and have your own transportation; Wat mag je verwachten? This is what we offer you: - A starting salary between €15,55 and €16,03
